What are the average marks obtained by all the six students in Hindi?
solution:
**Given:**

Marks obtained by six students in Hindi are given as percentages. Maximum marks in Hindi = 120.

**Formula used:**

Marks = (Percentage / 100) × Maximum Marks

Average marks in Hindi = (Sum of marks obtained by all students in Hindi) / (Number of students)

**Calculation:**

 
• Aanya: (90 / 100) × 120 = 108
 
• Aarav: (90 / 100) × 120 = 108
 
• Lavi: (80 / 100) × 120 = 96
 
• Monika: (100 / 100) × 120 = 120
 
• Devyansh: (100 / 100) × 120 = 120
 
• Tanmay: (70 / 100) × 120 = 84

Sum of marks = 108 + 108 + 96 + 120 + 120 + 84 = 636

Average marks = 636 / 6 = 106

**∴ The average marks obtained by all six students in Hindi is 106.**
